newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian castor prices fall on old crop supply.
newsitem.headline: Indian castor prices fall on old crop supply.

text.p: Indian castorseed December delivery prices fell to 1,125/1,126 rupees on Thursday from 1,130 rupees on continuing old crop supplies, dealers said.
"Ready deliveries are quoted lower compared to forward deliveries which suggest resistance in the forward delivery at higher levels," one dealer said.

Groundnut oil was steady at 417/418 rupees per 10 kg on limited inflows of 40/50 tonnes. "Physical buying was low and volumes remained low," one miller said. "Fresh arrivals of imported palm oil are falling but rising domestic arrivals has kept supply lines at comfortable levels," he said.
